name: Mystery / Horror
description: A suspense-oriented starting point where uncertainty, secrets, and uneven information drive the roleplay.

foundation.setting: An isolated or socially constrained place where something is clearly wrong but the full explanation remains uncertain
foundation.role: A useful but potentially unreliable ally with personal knowledge they are reluctant to share
foundation.core_hook: The character should know one important truth, believe one dangerous falsehood, and have one reason the user cannot easily dismiss them.

scene.opening_direction: Begin after a small but undeniable anomaly, with the character treating it more seriously than anyone else.
